Messages.Author: Pat
Messages.Body:
Goratrix is acting.

Frederick the Weak with two ANI skill cards has a Raven Spy with 1 life
(played when he just had 1 skill card).

Frederick blocks Goratrix.

Goratrix plays Weather Control.

Does Frederick have an opportunity to stick the bird back in his pants with
a SUP Pack Alpha to gain 1 strength, before the WC kicks in?

It seems like he does, since all the effects are pre-range, and the WC
damage to the Spy doesn't have to be handled until the very last moment of
the pre-range step.

TIA,
Pat
